## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Community & Contribution

**Figma frame:** _Community & Contribution_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-18 (buttons and states), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Community-focused section encouraging contributions, issue reporting, and collaboration with an image.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Community heading, supportive copy, and contribution calls to action.
- Visual treatment for contribution, issue reporting, and collaboration paths.
- Supporting image and responsive composition that retains CTA prominence.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile community and contribution frames.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Contribution, issue-reporting, and collaboration paths are clear
- [ ] Supporting image strengthens the community message
- [ ] Calls to action use UI-18 button instances where applicable
- [ ] Uses UI-17 tokens and UI-20 grid rules with sufficient dark-mode contrast
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
